craft_notes: Sthāyin: engaged kalā births knowing (fork: but, adjudicated). Rows: slight, kindled, reckoned. Rejected: tva nominalizer — killed: ungrammatical. Read aloud: kindling count.

lines: Thus, even so slight making — when truth is weighed,
a might of Māyā; where ingenuity is kindled,
what right acting needs to be made visible;
now, having kindled all her fire,
Māyā must eventually give birth to this — so it is reckoned.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ yat māyākāryaṃ tatra kiṃcit tv aviśiṣṭaṃ yat kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tatra vyāpriyamāṇā kalā vidyādiprasavahetuḥ iti nirūpitam
